title: Hints
description: Create clues for this title. Each hint type can be added once.
empty: No hints yet. Create the first clue for this title.
loadError: Hints could not be loaded. Try again.
missing: No hint available in the selected language.
imageNote: Icon and cost are assigned automatically for this type.
allTypes: All hint types have been created.
deleteDescription: This permanently deletes the hint and all its translations.
failed: The operation could not be completed. Your changes have been kept.
conflict: This hint type or language already exists. Refresh the hints to see the latest data.
fixedCost: Fixed cost assigned to this hint type.

image.title: Hint image
image.shared: This image is automatically available in all supported languages. Replacing it updates every language.
image.replace: Drop a new image here to replace the current one
image.formats: One JPG or PNG file, up to 10 MB.
image.invalid: Select a valid JPG/PNG image no larger than 10 MB.
image.description: Upload an image for this hint. No text is required.
image.resume: Part of the hint has already been saved. Retry to complete the remaining steps without creating it again.
image.uncertain: The save result could not be verified. Close this dialog and check the refreshed list before trying again.
image.confirmFailed: The image could not be confirmed. Retry to finish saving.
image.uploadFailed: Upload failed. Check your connection and retry.

languagesHint: The same text will be saved for each selected language. No automatic translation is performed.
